observations: Only exact /game/stop-verified remains exposed for public and child provider termination; legacy /game/stop is not publicly routed.
Provider cleanup claims ownership atomically, preserves the process token through valid ownership transfer and fails closed on absent or changed identity.
Terminal retry and housekeeping preserve the exact operation and cannot leave an orphan stream or an indefinitely occupied uncertain barrier.
Suspend and parent-child-child actor handoffs retain the required stream, app, generation, actor epoch and process fences.
A running replacement retires only the absent old token and closes the exact shared stream without stopping replacement process B.
The child profile uses the common provider and stream lifecycle; Playnite Bridge has no child provider session lifecycle.
